title: Direct-image chart comparison under etale base change
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, h:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′ be morphisms of algebraic spaces over S [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Suppose g and h are representably etale and their underlying sheaf square is cartesian. Use the chart direct images [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] and literal etale restrictions. There exists a natural module isomorphism f_* followed by restriction along g ≅ restriction along h followed by f′_*. For every module F, etale scheme V→Y′, chart q=(T→X′, T→V) of f′ over V, and section s of f_*F on gV, the projection of the image of s to q equals the projection of s to the chart (T→X′→X, T→V) of f over gV. The transport retains exactly the underlying scheme and map to V. No assumption of surjectivity of g, representability of f, or quasi-coherence on F is imposed.

proof.text: Extend to the enlarged etale sites and use the all-chart limit comparison to identify each specified direct image with the enlarged direct image, preserving every projection and scalar action.

Identify etale postcomposition with localization. The given cartesian square identifies the two localized base-change functors by (x,v)↦((x,g_V(v)),v), whose inverse forgets the middle coordinate. The defining fibre-product equation proves the inverse identities, including when g is not surjective. Structural ring maps pull back along the same triangles.

Apply ringed-site localization to this square and conjugate its direct-image comparison by the projection-preserving all-chart comparisons. On each chart the coordinate map retains T and its map to V; restriction of the extended section is therefore exactly the displayed projection. Naturality and scalar compatibility of the three isomorphisms give the natural module isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_directImage_chart_comparison
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (hg : IsEtale g.hom.hom) (hh : IsEtale h.hom.hom)
    (hp : IsPullback h.hom f'.hom f.hom g.hom) :
    let transport : ∀ V : Y'.EtaleSite, ModuleChart f' V →
        ModuleChart f ((etaleMap g hg).obj V) := fun V q ↦
      CostructuredArrow.mk (Y := (etaleMap h hh).obj q.left)
        (CostructuredArrow.homMk q.hom.left (by
          have hw : h.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom = f'.hom.hom ≫ g.hom.hom :=
            congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom) hp.w
          have hq : yoneda.map q.hom.left ≫ V.obj.hom =
              q.left.obj.hom ≫ f'.hom.hom := by
            exact CostructuredArrow.w q.hom
          change yoneda.map q.hom.left ≫ (V.obj.hom ≫ g.hom.hom) =
            q.left.obj.hom ≫ h.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom
          rw [← Category.assoc, hq, Category.assoc, hw]))
    ∃ beta : moduleDirectImage f ⋙ pullback g hg ≅
        pullback h hh ⋙ moduleDirectImage f',
      ∀ (F : X.Modules) (V : Y'.EtaleSite) (q : ModuleChart f' V)
        (s : ((moduleDirectImage f).obj F).val.obj (op ((etaleMap g hg).obj V))),
        ((moduleDirectImageModel f').projection ((pullback h hh).obj F) V).app (op q)
            ((beta.hom.app F).val.app (op V) s) =
          ((moduleDirectImageModel f).projection F ((etaleMap g hg).obj V)).app
            (op (transport V q)) s
